title_zh: ⚠️ 普發一萬元補助提醒｜認明官網防詐騙！
content_zh: 行政院宣布普發一萬元補助方案將於 11 月 5 日正式開放，請民眾認明官方網站「https://10000.gov.tw」，勿點陌生連結或提供個資。若接獲不明簡訊、電話或連結要求操作 ATM，務必提高警覺並撥打 165 反詐騙專線。
content_en: The Executive Yuan announced the NT$10,000 subsidy program will officially open on November 5. Please verify the official site 'https://10000.gov.tw' and do not click unknown links or provide personal data. If you receive suspicious messages or calls, contact the 165 anti-fraud hotline.

title_zh: 💡 節能家電補助延長申請期限
content_zh: 經濟部能源署公告，節能家電補助計畫延長至 2025 年底，民眾購買符合能效等級的冰箱、冷氣、洗衣機可申請現金回饋。
content_en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs announced that the Energy-Saving Appliance Subsidy has been extended until the end of 2025. Citizens purchasing approved energy-efficient appliances can apply for cashback.
